notice: Template only. All networks and payout signing remain disabled. The base reference price is the agreed starting price of 0.005 USDT per SOBY; demand adjustments use only completed orders whose deposits and payouts have both reached chain finality. referenceLiquidityUsdtBaseUnits is an operator-approved pricing-depth parameter, not an external USDT balance and does not require funding a USDT payout wallet. Before quote creation, set positive priceFloor/priceCeiling, positive per-order and per-network daily caps, feeBps (0-1000), and minimumInventoryBaseUnits. The quote provider reads the SOBYA native SOBY balance at a finalized RPC block on every quote and checks the RPC chain ID and observation age; it does not trust a balance copied into this file. Never put private keys or seed phrases in this file or repository. Store network-bound encrypted key files outside the repository and supply passphrases through local environment variables only. Deposit verification runs only when depositWatchEnabled and the relevant per-network flags are explicitly true. The API remains disabled by default and must be exposed only through a trusted TLS reverse proxy. Initial order direction is USDT-to-SOBY only; reverse direction remains disabled until each external USDT payout inventory is funded and independently verified.
